name: Block In Page 403
description: Provides a block-visibility condition that shows a block on the 403 (access denied) page.
project_description:
What's "Block In Page 403" ? 
 This module provides the ability to place a block on page 403.

 How to use this module ? 
 After the installation, You should go to /admin/structure/block, and then to configure an enabled block, you will have the ability to check on "Show on page 403".

 Please provide feedback and ideas to improve it!

 Complementary modules 
 Block Visibility Groups

 allows the site administrator to easily manage complex visibility settings that apply to any block placed in a visibility group. The visibility settings for all blocks in the group can be edited on one administration form.

 Block In Page 404

 This module provide the ability to place a block in 404 page or page not found.
